envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in navigation steps
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login steps
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_PASSWORD} in login steps

TD-CS-045-001.name: Valid Serialization Capture — Happy Path
TD-CS-045-001.expectedOutcome: Serialization data captured successfully; Goods Issue posted; EPCIS transmission successful; Delivery status Goods Issued

TD-CS-045-NEG-001.name: Invalid Serial Number Format — Non-GS1 Compliant
TD-CS-045-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Serial number format invalid or non-GS1 compliant; Serialization NOT saved; Delivery status remains Open

TD-CS-045-NEG-002.name: Duplicate Serial Number Within Same Delivery
TD-CS-045-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Duplicate serial number detected; Serialization NOT saved; Delivery status remains Open

TD-CS-045-NEG-003.name: Non-Serialized Material — No SERNP Flag
TD-CS-045-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: Serialization functionality NOT available for non-serialized material; Goods Issue can proceed without serialization

TD-CS-045-ERR-001.name: Missing Serialization Data — GI Blocked
TD-CS-045-ERR-001.note: Serialization data intentionally left incomplete to test GI blocking
TD-CS-045-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Serialization incomplete; Goods Issue blocked; Delivery status remains Open

TD-CS-045-ERR-002.name: Missing Batch Number — Mandatory Field
TD-CS-045-ERR-002.note: Batch Number field intentionally left empty to test mandatory field validation
TD-CS-045-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: System highlights Batch field as mandatory; Serialization NOT saved

TD-CS-045-ERR-003.name: Missing or Invalid Expiry Date — Mandatory Field
TD-CS-045-ERR-003.note: Expiry Date field left empty or set to past date to test validation
TD-CS-045-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: System highlights Expiry Date field as mandatory or invalid; Serialization NOT saved

TD-CS-045-EDGE-001.name: Minimum Quantity Boundary (Single Unit)
TD-CS-045-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Serialization captured for 1 unit; Goods Issue posted; EPCIS transmission successful

TD-CS-045-EDGE-002.name: Maximum Quantity Boundary
TD-CS-045-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Serialization captured for maximum quantity; Goods Issue posted; EPCIS transmission successful for all units

TD-CS-045-EDGE-003.name: Serial Number Minimum Length (15 Characters)
TD-CS-045-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Minimum-length serial number (15 characters) accepted; Serialization captured; Goods Issue posted

TD-CS-045-EDGE-004.name: Serial Number Maximum Length (34 Characters)
TD-CS-045-EDGE-004.expectedOutcome: Maximum-length serial number (34 characters) accepted without truncation; Serialization captured; Goods Issue posted

TD-CS-045-INT-001.name: EPCIS Transmission Failure
TD-CS-045-INT-001.note: Requires EPCIS endpoint to be unavailable (timeout/network error simulation)
TD-CS-045-INT-001.expectedOutcome: System detects EPCIS transmission failure; Error message displayed; GI blocked OR GI posted with EPCIS status Failed; Serialization data retained
